owner_rule: The first public launch announcement for an Evercraft product must occur at a time matching one of the children's birthday clock-face times.
clock_format: 12-hour clock; AM/PM not restricted in the founder's instruction and must be specified in each scheduled release
scope: first publicly distributed announcement of a product
first public distribution of a flagship commercial marketing a new product
first public introduction of a new commercial service
out_of_scope: private review files and production builds
ordinary updates to already publicly launched products
missed_window_policy: HOLD. Choose another explicit, founder-approved launch slot. Never publish late to approximate a missed birthdate time.
preconditions: specific founder approval of launch asset/account/payload
actual destination and customer contact tested
privacy_note: Policy preserves only three time strings, not children's identities or full birthdates.
